name: biofile-render-endpoint
description: API protegida para enviar un paciente específico de Google Sheets a BIOFILE usando Playwright.

scripts.start: node scripts/patch-job-progress.mjs && node scripts/patch-operacion-v5.mjs && node --check src/biofile.js && node --check src/google-sheets.js && node --check src/server.js && node src/server.js
scripts.dev: node --env-file=.env scripts/patch-job-progress.mjs && node --env-file=.env scripts/patch-operacion-v5.mjs && node --check src/biofile.js && node --check src/google-sheets.js && node --check src/server.js && node --env-file=.env src/server.js
